decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through devotion to green cards and using cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Cavalier of Thorns to generate advantage and pressure the opponent. With cards like Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan, the deck aims to bring out powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Ulvenwald Oddity to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx helps to further strengthen the devotion to green strategy, making this deck a fast and aggressive force to be reckoned with in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Amalia Benavides Aguirre along with cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to create a powerful life gain engine using Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck includes creatures like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker to gain life and stay alive while setting up the combo. It also includes cards like Alseid of Life's Bounty and Selfless Savior for protection and Fauna Shaman for tutoring. Overall, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and gain a lot of life to set up a game-winning Aetherflux Reservoir activation.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells like Wild Slash, Lightning Helix, and Play with Fire to remove threats and deal direct damage while deploying creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Slickshot Show-Off to apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of Monstrous Rage and Boros Charm adds additional reach and versatility to the deck, allowing for explosive finishes and efficient removal options. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck, ensuring consistent access to the necessary colors and resources.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play with early creature drops and disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to secure victories. The mana base allows for consistent casting of spells and creatures, while the inclusion of cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Bloodtithe Harvester provide additional synergies and support for the aggro strategy. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck revolves around utilizing various combo pieces such as Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Aetherflux Reservoir to generate a large amount of life gain and mana, while also utilizing cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search and tutor for key combo pieces. The deck also includes cards like Cenote Scout and Extract Specialist to help assemble the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker provide additional life gain and value. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent with a large amount of life gain and damage.

This deck focuses on generating life and creating a powerful board presence with cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Wildgrowth Walker, and Aetherflux Reservoir. The key strategy is to efficiently search for and play key combo pieces using cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company to create a strong board state while gaining life to fuel Aetherflux Reservoir's ability. The deck also includes removal and protection spells to help maintain control of the game and ensure the combo can be executed successfully.

Using a combination of cheap spells and card draw, this deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and bring them back to the battlefield for aggressive attacks. With options for removal and disruption, as well as ways to generate card advantage, the deck looks to overwhelm opponents with a quick and potent threat. The inclusion of cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster enhances the graveyard synergies, while cards like Temporal Trespass provide additional finishers if the game goes long.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with aggressive abilities and efficient ways to ramp up mana in order to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures and spells to keep the pressure on the opponent, with a mix of direct damage, protection, and card advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the colors needed for the deck's aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck is designed to be fast, relentless, and difficult to stop once it gets going.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost White creatures and using cards like Brave the Elements to protect them. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant provide additional support for the weenie strategy, while Anointed Peacekeeper and Containment Priest disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of creatures, with Mutavault and Cavern of Souls providing additional utility. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and quickly close out the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix, while controlling the board with burn spells and counterspells. It also utilizes cards like Ledger Shredder and Treasure Cruise to draw and filter through the deck efficiently. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster adds a disruptive element to the deck, allowing for additional damage and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Wildgrowth Walker, and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a significant amount of life and deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Collected Company, Chord of Calling, and Fauna Shaman to search for key creatures and spells needed for the combo. The inclusion of cards like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition provide protection and disruption against the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game through a massive life gain burst.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to pressure the opponent quickly. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan and removal spells like Fatal Push to keep the board clear. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support and utility for the aggro strategy. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats and disruption, while maintaining a consistent mana base with a mix of black and red lands.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent with early creature aggression, disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, and synergies with cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also includes a mix of removal and resilient threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Silversmote Ghoul to keep up the pressure. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of lands that produce both black and red mana, along with utility lands for additional value.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Llanowar Elves, in order to play powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to draw additional cards and maintain pressure on the opponent. By establishing a strong board presence early on and consistently adding to it with efficient threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It utilizes cards like Cauldron Familiar, Vein Ripper, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to create a fast clock and drain the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive cards such as Thoughtseize and Sheoldred's Edict to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistent plays, with a mix of lands that provide both colored and colorless mana sources.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on playing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross early on, supported by disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes ways to pump up its creatures and gain life like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. With a mix of removal spells, efficient creatures, and ways to generate advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.
